"The batteries-included agent harness." Built on langgraph.
Written in Python; a TypeScript version lives at langchain-ai/deepagentsjs.

Built-in capabilities: a virtual filesystem for context management, AI/Agent/Subagent spawning, long-term memory in AGENTS.md files, AI/Agent/Skills, task planning, and AI/Workflow/Human in the Loop approval.
Every deep agent gets file tools: ls, read_file, write_file, edit_file, delete, glob and grep. With a sandbox backend it also gets execute for shell commands.
